heading: INT. ROOFTOP CALL CENTRE - HOTEL TERRACE - DAY

units.text: INT. ROOFTOP CALL CENTRE - HOTEL TERRACE - DAY
Forty headsets under striped parasols on the roof of a failing seaside hotel.
Seagulls wheel overhead.
Customers are reached by phone, by hope, and by the mercy of a hot wind that keeps lifting the scripts from the tables.
ROSALEEN FINNEGAN, fifties, supervisor, walks the rows with a megaphone slung from her shoulder and a thermos of tea.
JAMAL TURNER, thirties, team lead, reads a script in a monotone.
BIANCA ESTRADA, twenties, newest hire, listens to a caller with her hand over her mouth.
KOJO ASARE, forties, quality assurance, sits apart with a stopwatch, a clipboard, and a face like a closed door.
Remember, people! A smile can be heard down the line!
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: Thank you for holding.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Bianca covers the mouthpiece and looks up at Rosaleen, who ignores her.
Kojo clicks the stopwatch and writes a figure on his clipboard.

A gust flips three scripts off Jamal's table; he chases them across the tiles, snatching, swearing under his breath, while Rosaleen steps neatly over a paper in her path and keeps walking, thermos aloft.
Ms. Finnegan. The customer says his house is on fire.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: Is it our house?
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: No.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: Then follow the script.
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: But he said--
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: Page four. "I understand your frustration."
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: Bianca nods.
She uncovers the mouthpiece.
Kojo clicks the stopwatch again, scratches another figure, and glances at Rosaleen with the faintest lift of one eyebrow.
Jamal returns with the scripts clutched to his chest, slaps them on the table, and slumps into his chair.
Kojo. How many?
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Forty-one this hour.
units.name: KOJO

units.text: Forty-one what?
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: Complaints we failed to resolve.
units.name: KOJO

units.text: That's... normal.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: It was twelve yesterday.
units.name: KOJO

units.text: Jamal glances at Rosaleen.
She is cheerfully yelling encouragement through the megaphone at a row of headsets.
A wave breaks on the beach far below.
Bianca pushes her headset off one ear and stares at the horizon.
Sir? Sir, I'm sorry. I can hear it. I can hear the fire.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: She stands.
The chair falls over behind her.
Jamal rises to catch it.
Kojo's stopwatch clicks.
Rosaleen turns, megaphone halfway to her mouth.
Bianca. Sit.
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: Sir, give me your address.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: Bianca, that is not on the script.
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: Bianca tears off the headset and drops it on the table.
She picks up the phone, the real one, the one with a cord.
She dials three digits and holds it to her ear.
Jamal steps beside her.
Kojo, slowly, sets down his clipboard.
Yes. There's a fire at forty-two Marlow Road.
units.name: BIANCA

units.text: Bianca!
units.name: ROSALEEN

units.text: Jamal turns to Rosaleen.
He takes the megaphone off her shoulder with one hand, unhurried, and sets it on the table.
Rosaleen. Shut up.
units.name: JAMAL

units.text: The terrace goes silent.
Forty heads turn.
The wind lifts the scripts and carries them over the parapet, white wings falling into the sea.
